items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: he said, you and Huston, and, and, uh, John F. Womerson, and Albert Six, you'll come over here and play... So, all right. We told him it was all right... I said, that is, I was playing my part for nothing.

ctx.x: I thought about the flag raisin, because you put it on that tape back. Yeah. Tell Mr. Russell about the flag raisin when you told us.

Oh, yeah. Well, the first flag raisin I believe they had was a barber, Johnny Hommel. He used to like music. And he says, I'm gonna, I'm gonna have a flag raisin here, such a night. And he said, I wanna see if you fellas, he said, you and Huston, and, and, uh, John F. Womerson, and Albert Six, you'll come over here and play. He said, if there's any charges, I'll pay you whatever's necessary. So, all right. We told him it was all right. It was a patriotic layout, and, we'd play. For nothing. I said, that is, I was…
